headline: 10–30s videos lift views/follower growth 2.59× — the single biggest measured gene across 87 travel-hack videos.
moves: Cut your next travel hack to 10–30 seconds (2.59× lift, n=17) — this format appears in 24% of top-quartile videos vs just 5% of bottom-quartile.
Post it with no spoken voiceover (2.48× lift, n=17) — 29% of top-quartile videos use no voice vs 10% of bottom-quartile.
Open with a POV/framing text overlay (1.94× lift, n=10) and add a spoken CTA (1.78× lift, n=10) — each appears in 10% of top-quartile videos vs 5% of bottom.
avoid: Stop making text-heavy videos — they underperform at 0.42× lift (n=71), and ALL-CAPS overlays are even worse at 0.44× (n=66).
hooks: POV: you're at the hotel front desk and they just handed you the worst room in the building
